--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[DB-1] Checkout writes not wrapped in a transaction
File: src/app/api/checkout/create-order/route.ts (L1-L220)
Evidence: Coupon quantity is read and updated outside any transaction, user/order existence checks and per-item create/update/delete operations are performed with sequential awaits inside loops (multiple prisma.orderItem.update/create/delete calls) without an enclosing prisma.$transaction. This allows races and partial commits (coupon decrement or some orderItems may succeed while other writes fail).
Impact: Breaks at ~50 concurrent checkouts — causes data inconsistency (overspent coupons, partially-updated orders) and can surface as order/payment mismatch or lost items under moderate concurrency.  
Fix: Wrap coupon decrement, order create/update, and all orderItem upserts/deletes in a single transaction (prisma.$transaction) and use atomic conditional updates (e.g., decrement WHERE quantity > 0) or SELECT ... FOR UPDATE patterns to prevent races.

[DB-2] PrismaClient not cached in production (connection risk)
File: src/lib/prisma.ts (L1-L40)
Evidence: The module only assigns globalForPrisma.prisma when NODE_ENV !== "production", so in production new PrismaClient instances are created without caching, creating new DB connections per module load / cold start.  
Impact: In serverless deployments this will exhaust the database connection limit quickly (connection pool exhaustion) at tens-to-hundreds of concurrent function instances, causing auth/query failures and high latency.  
Fix: Cache the PrismaClient on globalThis regardless of NODE_ENV (store instance on globalThis.prisma) so serverless cold starts reuse the client and reduce connections, or use a pooler (PgBouncer) + appropriate pool settings.

This allows races and partial commits (coupon decrement or some orderItems may succeed while other writes fail).
Impact: Breaks at ~50 concurrent checkouts — causes data inconsistency (overspent coupons, partially-updated orders) and can surface as order/payment mismatch or lost items under moderate concurrency.

[DB-2] PrismaClient not cached in production (connection risk)
File: src/lib/prisma.ts (L1-L40)
Evidence: The module only assigns globalForPrisma.prisma when NODE_ENV !== "production", so in production new PrismaClient instances are created without caching, creating new DB connections per module load / cold start.  
Impact: In serverless deployments this will exhaust the database connection limit quickly (connection pool exhaustion) at tens-to-hundreds of concurrent function instances, causing auth/query failures and high latency.  
Fix: Cache the PrismaClient on globalThis regardless of NODE_ENV (store instance on globalThis.prisma) so serverless cold starts reuse the client and reduce connections, or use a pooler (PgBouncer) + appropriate pool settings.

--- WARNING FINDINGS ---

[DB-3] Unbounded product listing queries (no pagination)
File: src/app/api/products/route.ts (L1-L200) and src/app/api/products/category/[category]/route.ts (L1-L200)
Evidence: product.findMany() is called without take/limit/cursor/pagination (and includes related colors), and category route also runs findMany with filters but no pagination or result limits.  
Impact: At higher QPS or with large product tables this will drive full-table scans and huge result payloads, causing query latency, DB CPU/IOPS spikes, and slow HTTP responses.  
Fix: Add cursor/limit (page) or keyset pagination and projection (select only needed columns) and move expensive includes to separate endpoints or lazy-load.

[DB-4] Loading full review arrays in product detail (aggregate misuse)
File: src/app/api/products/[slug]/route.ts (L1-L200)
Evidence: product.findUnique includes reviews and then computes averageRating/reviewCount by iterating over product.reviews (loads every review row into app memory).  
Impact: For popular products with many reviews this increases DB bandwidth and app CPU, causing slow responses and memory pressure at scale.  
Fix: Use DB-side aggregates (prisma.review.aggregate or count/avg queries) or a limited recent-review fetch instead of including the entire reviews array.

[DB-5] Missing indexes on high-traffic filter/sort columns
File: prisma/schema.prisma (L1-L200)
Evidence: Product queries filter by category/isActive/stock/price and order by createdAt or price, but schema.prisma does not define indexes on category, isActive, price, or createdAt (no @@index on these fields).  
Impact: When product table grows to ~100k+ rows these filters and ORDER BY will cause sequential scans and expensive sorts, degrading latency and increasing DB CPU/IOPS.  
Fix: Add targeted indexes (for example composite indexes on (category, isActive, createdAt) and index on price when used for range queries) and audit other high-traffic WHERE/ORDER columns.

--- INFO ---

[DB-6] Cart mutations use transactions (good)
File: src/app/api/cart/items/route.ts (L1-L260)
Evidence: Cart add/update/delete handlers wrap multi-step mutations in prisma.$transaction and maintain cart total by reading cart items inside the transaction.
